training_data.name: synthetic-indian-merchants
training_data.description: Generated from a hand-written lexicon of Indian merchants and bill items (backend/app/pipeline/lexicon.py) with simulated OCR noise.

calibration.fitted_on: validation split of the evaluation run (train-split model); reused for this refit

abstention.rule: suggest 'Uncategorised' when calibrated top probability < threshold

evaluation.dataset: synthetic; merchants and item words disjoint across train/val/test

selection.rule: highest validation macro-F1 among logreg, complement_nb

intended_use: Suggest a spending category for a personal expense from merchant name and item text. The user confirms every suggestion.
limitations: Trained and evaluated on synthetic data only - no real labelled Indian expense data was available.
An unseen merchant name with no item text is often ambiguous; expect many abstentions there.
Per-user corrections override the model for known merchants; the global model only changes on retrain.
